column4: The Auditor-General may, from time to time, give

column3: the staff of the Audit Office or any person authorized by him
such  general  and  special  directions,  in  writing  as  to  the
exercise  and  discharge  of  its  powers  and  functions  when
conducting an audit and the staff or any person authorized
by him shall give effect to such direction.

column4: (1)  No  liability,  whether  civil  or  criminal,  shall

column3: attach to the Auditor-General, any officer of the Sri Lanka
State Audit Service, any officer of the National Audit Office
or any other person assisting in the discharge of the duties of
the  Auditor-General  as  referred  to  in  section  9(1)(a),  for
anything which in good faith is done in the performance or
exercise of any function or power imposed or assigned under
the provisions of this Act.

column4: (2)  Any  expense  incurred  by  the  Auditor-General,  an

column3: officer of the Sri Lanka State Audit Service, any officer of
the National Audit Office or any other person assisting in
the discharge of the duties of the Auditor-General as referred
to  in  section  8(a),  as  the  case  may  be,  in  any  suit  or
prosecution brought against him before any court in respect
of any act which is done by him under this Act shall, if the
court holds that such act was done in good faith, be paid out
of the Consolidated Fund, unless such expenses are recovered
by him in such suit or prosecution.

column4: All members of the Commission, officers and staff

column3: of the Audit Office shall be deemed to be public servants
within the meaning and for the purposes of the Penal Code.

column4: The Audit Office shall be deemed to be a Scheduled

column3: Institution within the meaning of the Bribery Act, and the
provisions of that Act, shall be construed accordingly.
